question: Should currencyscoop.com be added as an alias of the CurrencyBeacon vendor entity in registry/entities.tsv?
why: currencyscoop.com and api.currencyscoop.com answer 301 redirects to currencybeacon.com, and free-for.dev still lists the old name, so scripts/fr entity CurrencyScoop finds no entity until the alias exists. A registry change is outside a lane's write scope.
